verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents two API surfaces: a Customer Agent API for taking requests outside a ticketing system, and the ability to run the Internal Agent from your own tools via the API. Because the Internal Agent configures flows from natural-language prompts, the API may indirectly reach much of what the UI does, but nothing documents UI parity, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity documentation, an API reference or OpenAPI spec, documented API coverage of pages like Releases, Automations, knowledge version history and approvals, and independent corroboration.
